items.q: Well, the Howards and McCulloughs--they almost cover the little city of Steubenville, Ohio

ctx.x: And he passed. It was a large family. Well, the Howards and McCulloughs--they almost cover the little city of Steubenville, Ohio (laughter). So, that was about it. I didn't want the article to get mixed up, you know.
Okay. Fine, thank you. Mr. Howard, your Uncle Walter was a choir director here in Los Angeles then, too?
